verdict.rationale: Spending limits are a fair question for a cloud hosting platform, so the axis applies, but no Netlify documentation in the pack describes hard spending caps or budget limits. Community reports of a $104k bill after a DDoS suggest usage was not capped, but there is no vendor claim to dispute, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can set hard spending limits to control my cloud costs
